scene_description: Granite countertop with a folded gray sweatshirt on the left and a black-cased iPad on the right. A white charger rests on the back of the iPad near the backsplash.

targets.name: black iPad
targets.description: Black-cased iPad lying screen-down on the right side of the countertop, with the white charger on its back.
nearby_obstacles: White charger resting on its back
Backsplash close to its rear edge
targets.clearance_notes: Outer edges are exposed, but the charger loads part of the back. The backsplash limits access along the rear edge. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the white charger off the iPad and place it approximately 20 cm diagonally forward-right on clear countertop, outside the area where the iPad will be placed. Keep the charger fully supported.
After removing the charger, move the black iPad approximately 20 cm toward the front edge of the counter, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: Dimensions treated as the photographed iPad with its case. Remove the charger before moving or tilting the tablet. Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: white charger
targets.description: Small white plug-in charger resting on the black iPad, with metal prongs facing upward.
targets.orientation: resting with plug prongs facing upward
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed; no other object covers or presses against the charger. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the charger from the iPad and move the white charger approximately 25 cm toward the front edge of the counter, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: The charger is unobstructed but set back on the iPad; repositioning could improve access from the counter front. Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: gray sweatshirt
targets.description: Folded gray sweatshirt on the left side of the granite countertop, to the left of the black iPad, with a sleeve extending toward the front edge.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and side edges are exposed, with no objects resting on the sweatshirt. The front sleeve is near the counter edge and accessible.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions describe the folded sweatshirt. Fabric can change shape when lifted.

source: Staged permutation of S0026, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
